== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Lord Vader (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-D-lordvader-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-13E-Lord_Vader.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Dark Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “[Pilot] 3. May steal (and then use) an opponent's lightsaber just lost from same site; may then use two weapons. While The Quick And Easy Path on table, Jedi Escape and What Was It? may not cancel duels. Immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1230_13</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
